Summary: "You have a clear report structure and a well-motivated coral-bleaching mission, with launch, orbit, ground station, duration and EOL covered and STK screenshots/access table included. To reach Accomplished, correct the SSO inclination and Kourou latitude, reconcile contact-duration claims with your access data, justify Mt Pleasant as TT&C, include STK files, and strengthen referencing." Count words ~60. Good.

Next_steps: 3 strings. Need actionable. 
1. "Revisit the orbital mechanics: recompute SSO inclination for 600 km (about 97.8°, retrograde) and correct the Kourou latitude to about 5.2°N; update the orbit graph/text so they agree and justify the launch-window claim."
2. "Recalculate and rewrite the communications section from your access table: mean 580.786 s is ~9.7 min (max ~12.8 min), not 'almost twenty minutes'; explain the Mt Pleasant Radio Observatory TT&C justification or choose an appropriate ground station."
3. "Add the STK software files (or appendix links) and replace bare-URL/Wikipedia references with properly cited, authoritative sources; also correct the high-altitude/low-resolution sentence and ensure conclusions cover EOL and mission duration."

Criteria:
C1 <=70 words: "You clearly explain the mission need, rationale and why one spacecraft suffices, with references. To move from Adequate to Accomplished, explicitly identify the operator and customers (e.g., marine/conservation scientists and Australian facilities) and add specific literature support for the user/operations model." Count ~45.

C2 <=70: "You cover launch, orbit, ground control, duration and EOL with STK screenshots and an access table. However, the SSO inclination (87.79° prograde vs ~97.8°), Kourou latitude (45.05°N vs ~5.2°N) and contact duration (~9.7 min mean, not ~20 min) are major errors. Accomplished requires corrected, reconciled calculations, STK files and justified ground-station choice." ~55.

C3 <=70: "You reach conclusions linked to launch, orbit and ground-station choices. To reach Accomplished, make them specific to your results, include mission duration and EOL outcomes, and avoid repeating unresolved design errors (e.g., SSO/polar wording). Tie each conclusion back to evidence in the main body." ~45.

C4 <=70: "Your report has clear headings, an executive summary and labelled figures/tables. To reach Accomplished, professionalise presentation: number tables, make captions consistent, fix grammar/typos, replace bare-URL and Wikipedia references with properly formatted sources, and ensure in-text citations match the reference list." ~45.

Need ensure no markdown. JSON object. Use double quotes. Need escape? Fine. Need no extra.
